feral cave leave.title: Feral Cave
feral cave leave.text:
You leave the feral cave behind and set off for a return to Stone Henge.
You enter the dark, sticky webbed tunnels.

Sugar: [...Wait, you hear that?]

feral cave leave 2.title: Feral Cave
feral cave leave 2.text:
Lucid: [You alright?]

Pemmi: [Look!]

Pemmi shoots her spell light into the darkness further down the tunnel.
You see at least 5 more spiders crawling toward you.

Sugar: [No chance, we gotta run back inside!]

You hurry back into the feral caves.
Curious feral residents come out of their caves to watch you.

Cheese: [What the hell was that? Why so many all of a sudden?]

Sugar: [Looks like they let you in on purpose. They've trapped us in here. Maybe they wanted to feed their feral friends.]

You wait in the caverns for a bit, but the spiders don't seem to bother chasing you.

Lucid: [It's very strange how they don't seem to chase us in this cave. Let's go back and rest.]

feral cave.title: Feral Cave
feral cave.text:
You are at feral cave.
It is a giant, open underground cave lit with glowing mushrooms.
Feral residents peek out of their shelters on the cavern walls from time to time.

feral cave defeat.title: Feral Cave
feral cave defeat.text:
You collapse.

Your companions drag you back to safety.

feral cave converse 4.title: Feral Cave
feral cave converse 4.text:
Pemmi: [We've been here for a while. We should try leaving through the tunnels, there should be less spiders.]

Your group pack up and leave the caverns.

feral cave converse 4 2.title: Feral Cave
feral cave converse 4 2.text:
After ten minutes of walking, you enter the sticky webbed tunnels again.

Pemmi: [Hold on, let me shoot my spell light forward.]

Pemmi's ball of light reveals two spiders staring at you down the tunnel.
They all start growling.

Sugar: [Aight, let's back out.]

Pemmi: [No, there's only four of them, we can get through!]

feral cave leave 5-3.title: Feral Cave
feral cave leave 5-3.text:
Lucid: [You are right. Pemmi, we should retreat back. Those spiders are just staring at us... There's definitely more behind them.]

Your group decide to head back to the caverns.

Sugar: [Like I said, they got a cattle farm going. Even if we manage to kill some of them, they just replace the guards. No point risking our lives trying to fight.]

Pemmi: [Well, what do you suggest then?]

Sugar: [We're doomed.]

Lucid: [Sugar, you said there is a door deep down in the caverns, right? We should rest here for a bit then try the door.]

feral cave leave 5-1.title: Feral Cave
feral cave leave 5-1.text:
You collapse.
Somehow, your team manages to take down the spiders and drag you back to the caverns.
Lucid and Pemmi take turns mending your broken bones and sealing your flesh with magic.

Pemmi: [Ok, that was close. I guess we can't make it through.]

Sugar: [Like I said, they got a cattle farm going. Even if we kill some of them, they just replace the guards. We're won't make it out.]

Pemmi: [Well, what do you suggest then?]

Sugar: [We're doomed.]

Lucid: [Sugar, you said there is a door deep down in the caverns, right? We should rest here for a bit then try the door.]

feral cave leave 5-2.title: Feral Cave
feral cave leave 5-2.text:
You try to go deeper in, but you hear large amount of growling from deeper down the tunnel.
You run back to the caverns.

Pemmi: [There were nowhere near that amount of spiders when we entered! This is ridiculous!]

Sugar: [Those spiders let you in here on purpose. This place is a cattle farm. They're not going to let us out.]

Pemmi: [What do you suggest then?]

Sugar: [We're doomed.]

Lucid: [Sugar, you said there is a door deep down in the caverns, right? We should heal up then try the door.]

feral cave converse 1.title: Feral Cave
feral cave converse 1.text:
Sugar: [I tried to escape with some other sane people here. Every time we tried, we were chased by the spiders back into this cavern. My guess is that they keep us in here like cattle or something. I don't know who these ferals are, but maybe they're domesticated cattle for the spiders or something.]

Pemmi: [If the people of Stone Henge knew what was going on, they would try to free these people!]

Sugar: [These spiders are no joke. Even if the entire Stone Henge comes marching down it'll take serious dedication to defeat these monsters. We should worry about ourselves first.]

feral cave converse 2.title: Feral Cave
feral cave converse 2.text:
Sugar: [I... I need to get out of this dirt hole. I hate everything about this place.]

Pemmi: [Really? I thought this place would feel similar to Ant Hill.]

Sugar: [What the hell are you saying? Don't insult us, you rock-chewing guest-kidnapping pollen-sniffing maggot!]

feral cave converse 3.title: Feral Cave
feral cave converse 3.text:
Pemmi: [Cheer up, Cheese. I'll teach you how to cast spells.]

Cheese: [Okay.]

Pemmi takes Cheese to a corner and shows him a book.

feral cave converse 5.title: Feral Cave
feral cave converse 5.text:
Pemmi: [So what do we do? Are there any other way out?]

Sugar: [There is some door leading to what looks like the deeper caves. There's sounds coming from behind that door, I wouldn't recommend it.]

feral cave leave 7.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 7.text:
Sugar leads your group to a room deep in the caverns.
There is a giant gaping hole in the center of the room with fragile wooden spiral stairs leading down the hole.

Sugar: [Careful, if you trip, you go splat.]

You reach the pitch black bottom.
Strange moaning sounds come from behind the door.

Lucid: [This smell... It's from rotting human flesh. We should couple up to watch each other's backs. You with me and Sugar with Pemmi. Cheese, you should stay out of the fights and make sure our retreat is clear.]

Lucid opens the door.

feral cave leave 7 defeat.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 7 defeat.text:
You collapse.

...

Pemmi: [Are you ok?]

You get up and see that your companions have beaten all of the monsters.

Lucid: [Ugh... Let's... retreat back to the caverns. These things are quite strong, and there could be more nearby.]

feral cave leave 8.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 8.text:
Lucid: [The walking dead... This is the wicked result of cannibalization.]

Sugar: [Are you telling me that I'll turn into one of these things?]

Lucid: [If you keep eating human flesh for years, perhaps.]

Sugar: [Well shit, more reason for us to get the hell outta here.]

You continue past the door down the pitch black dirt tunnels.
The entire place is saturated with foul miasma.

Pemmi: [Looks like we're at a split. There is a door on our left and a dirt tunnel on our right. Which way do you think we should go?]

feral cave leave 9-1.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 9-1.text:
Sugar: [Why would you choose the hole? What a shitty scout.]

You proceed into the dirt tunnel.
The low ceiling and narrow, curvy path makes you claustrophobic.
Your group walk through the tunnel in single file, with you in the lead.

You bump into something.
It's a standing corpse.

feral cave leave 9-1 2.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 9-1 2.text:
Lucid: [Continuing on like this is a bad idea. Let's go back. We'll try the door.]

You return to the large room and enter the door.

feral cave leave 9-2.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 9-2.text:
Pemmi: [This place looks pretty safe. Wooden floor, furniture, and less disgusting smell. I'm gonna close the door behind us.]

Lucid: [Look, weapon racks full of spears. Tipped with silver for fighting zombies. Take a look.]

feral cave leave 11.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 11.text:
Cheese picks up an amulet on a wooden shelf.

Cheese: [What's this?]

Lucid: [That... looks like an Artifact.]

Cheese: [What's an Artifact?]

Lucid: [Artifacts are items embedded with powerful spells. Those items are crafted in a way that we don't understand... They can't be replicated, which usually means they're incredibly valuable.]

Cheese: [Nice, this is mine now.]

Motivated by Cheese's fortune, you search the shelf and find a glass rod. Nice!

feral cave leave 12.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 12.text:
You leave the safe room behind and proceed into the dirt tunnel.
You enter a much larger hall with strange metal furniture and rails on the floor.

Lucid: [This... looks like an ancient mine. Which is good news, because that means this place is likely to have another exit that may not be guarded by the spiders.]

Pemmi: [What is a mine?]

Lucid: [Of course, Stone Henge nor Ant Hill know how to forge metals... Very interesting... So this is an ancient ruin from another civilization. In the frontier, too. Hmm.]

Sugar: [You know what this place is? This is an ancient ruin?]

Lucid: [This is a ruin, yes. Ruins are filled with interesting artifacts and puzzling structures. We may find more than just silver spears in these places. There's no chance that any spelunkers made it down here, so we may be in for some fortune.]

Pemmi: [Eeeeek!! Cheese, what the?!]

You turn around to see Cheese's body and clothing turn purple... until he is some kind of a translucent ghost.

Cheese: [Woo! Look at me!]

Lucid: [Ah, it looks like the amulet he picked up earlier was a transformation amulet! Very nice! If he can come back to human form, that is.]

Suddenly, you hear strange moaning sound.
You turn back around to see zombies coming from around the corner.

Pemmi: [Sorry, I may have yelled too loud. Cheese scared me.]

feral cave leave 13.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 13.text:
Your group takes down the zombies with ease, thanks to Cheese's newly found powers.

Sugar: [Hey, that artifact is pretty good! Give me that!]

Sugar tries to snatch the artifact from Cheese, but Cheese stuns her with mysterious force.

Cheese: [Never!]

Pemmi: [We should definitely search this entire area for useful items. This is amazing!]

Lucid: [Yes, we could make enough fortune to last a lifetime here. But if we can't escape from here, no amount of artifact will be of use. We should stick together for now.]

You walk around the mining complex looking for a way out.
Purple Cheese follow you from behind without a sound. He seems pretty excited for his newly found power.

Lucid: [This whole area seems pretty secure. I think the rooms that we just passed by may have some valuable artifacts. We could spend some time looting the place. But let's be careful. We should never walk alone here. Let's form a group.]

feral cave leave 14.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 14.text:
Lucid: [Ok. We'll look for artifacts for half an hour and meet back here.]

Everyone scatters.

%?temp: [Alright, let's do this. One for you, then one for me.]

You return to the dormitory complex and start looting.

feral cave leave 15-1.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 15-1.text:
You finish looting and assess what you've found.

Pemmi: [So here's what we found: A hand crossbow, a potion, a runed staff, bunch of clothes, and some wooden beads. Since you already have an artifact, I'll pick mine first.]

Pemmi picks the hand crossbow.

feral cave leave 15-2.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 15-2.text:
You finish looting and assess what you've found.

Lucid: [So, it looks like we've found a hand crossbow, a potion of experience, and a kidney staff. Since you already have one artifact, I will take the first pick and take the staff.]

feral cave leave 15-3.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 15-3.text:
You finish looting and assess what you've found.

Cheese: [Looks like we didn't find anything.]

You notice that Cheese is casually holding a staff that you've never seen before.

feral cave leave 15-4.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 15-4.text:
You finish looting and assess what you've found.

Sugar: [Nice. A hand crossbow, staff, and a potion. I'll take this potion and this hand crossbow. I don't think this staff is any useful to a scout, so I'll take it as well.]

opt.to: >encounter>Sugar the hoarder>@feral cave leave 15-4 2>>item>hand crossbow>@feral cave leave 15-4 3
opt.text: Take the hand crossbow by force

opt.to: >encounter>Sugar the hoarder>@feral cave leave 15-4 2>>item>kidney staff>@feral cave leave 15-4 3
>encounter>Sugar the hoarder>@feral cave leave 15-4 2>@feral cave leave 15-4 4

feral cave leave 15-4 2.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 15-4 2.text: Sugar: [Ha, you piece of shit. I wasn't anywhere as weak as you are even when I was a lil scout.]

feral cave leave 15-4 3.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 15-4 3.text: Sugar: [Ha, you pack a punch. You deserve it, take it.]

feral cave leave 15-4 4.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 15-4 4.text:
Sugar: [Ha, you pack a punch. You deserve it, take it.]

Sugar points at the potion on the ground.
You see that the potion had been shattered from violent motions...

feral cave leave 16.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 16.text:
You return to the rendezvous.
Everyone is already there, showing off their new artifacts.

Lucid: [It doesn't look like we've found anything that would help us get out of here... But we did find things that will help us fight the zombies, so good enough. Let's proceed into the main tunnels, then.]

feral cave leave 17.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 17.text:
You continue along the rails.
Deeper in the mines, you start seeing glowing mushrooms again, lighting the way.

You exit the tunnel into a giant cave with high ceiling, with a crevice to the surface in the distance where sunlight shines down from.

Sugar: [YES!! Sunlight! Finally!]

Pemmi: [Wait, what the hell is THAT?]

Directly below the crevice is a strange dirt mound bathing in the sunlight.
Upon a closer look, it looks like it's slowly expanding and shrinking, as if breathing.

Pemmi: [Could it be a creature? It's conveniently blocking our route... let's just sneak past it.]

You carefully approach the mound.
On a closer look, you realize that it is an amalgamation of flesh, moving as one, covered in faint blue glowing mushrooms.

Lucid: [This... is an abomination, hordes of moving corpses attracted to sunlight, melted to each other! This...]

Cheese sneezes.

The mound rises...

feral cave leave 18.title: Deeper Caves
feral cave leave 18.text:
Lucid: [Ugh... is everyone alright? Let's take some time to heal.]

Sugar: [I don't know how you guys even made it here with that kind of fighting... Let's just go... I'm sick of this shit.]

You enter the tunnel behind the dead, rotting mass.
At the end of the tunnel you find a hole high up above where you can see the light shining from the outside.

A tall wooden ladder is conveniently placed all the way to the top.

feral cave leave 19.title: Woods
feral cave leave 19.text:
Your group climb the ladder up to the top.

You find yourself in a natural dirt cave completely free of webs.
You can see sunlight shining in the distance.
Sugar runs towards the sunlight.

Sugar: [Ahhhh! YES!]

You have returned to the surface.

henge woods.title: Woods
henge woods.text:
It is %time.
You sit on the green grass with everyone and enjoy the surface breeze.

Cheese: [Wow, these ant egg biscuits are really good!]

Pemmi: [Thanks, this is actually my first time cooking.]

Sugar: [Finally! something other than mushrooms and human meat!]

You finish your delicious biscuits and look around.
The leaves of the trees in Stone Henge woods are starting to turn red.
You wonder where Cobby is right now.

Sugar: [So this man named Lucid. What a funny guy, why did he go through all that trouble to help us?]

Pemmi: [He's a nice person. I helped you guys too when I found out about all this.]

Sugar: [Foolish.]

Cheese: [So where do we go now?]

Sugar: [I'm going back to Ant Hill. I'm gonna teach that son of a bitch some lesson. Also I need to get my equipment from my dormitory.]

Cheese: [And where to after you are done with Ant Hill?]

Sugar: [Don't know... Maybe I'll go to that Jericho place. Or maybe if I kill your dad they won't bother me in Ant Hill.]

Pemmi: [Uh... Cheese, you want to go hunting? We're out of food.]

Cheese: [Naw, I'm going to take a nap.]

Pemmi: [Alright... Guess I'll go alone.]

henge woods 2.title: Woods
henge woods 2.text:
You are out in the woods hunting for food with Pemmi.

Pemmi: [Don't you think Lucid is great? I don't know what we would've done without him.]

You ask her what she thinks of Cobby.

Pemmi: [Cobby? He looks a bit like Sugar, don't you think?]

She goes on and on complaining about Sugar.

Pemmi: [You know, the last couple weeks have been a wild ride for me. I think I'll go to Jericho with Lucid. There's little I can do in Stone Henge...]

You continue searching for prey with Pemmi.

henge woods 3.title: Woods
henge woods 3.text:
You return to camp to see the bonfire burnt out and Cheese curled up in front of it, crying.

Pemmi: [Cheese! What happened? Are you okay?]

Cheese: [It's Sugar! She beat me and took my amulet!]

Pemmi: [Oh, no! Where is Sugar now?]

Cheese continues crying angrily.

---

It is %time.
You see Lucid returning to camp, packed up with all his stuff from the Inn.

Lucid: [I'm back. I brought food from Dolomite Inn.]

Pemmi: [Lucid! You're back!]

Lucid: [Yes, it's time for me to return to Jericho. Where's Sugar?]

You explain what happened to Lucid.

Cheese: [I bet he ran to Ant Hill. I'm going to get my amulet back.]

Pemmi: [Cheese, do you really want to go all the way back to Ant Hill? You guys should just come with me and Lucid to Jericho. There's nothing for us here.]

Lucid: [That is not true. You probably want to return to Ant Hill to find Cobby, don't you?]

opt.text: I need to return to Ant Hill to find Cobby

to ant hill.title: Woods
to ant hill.text:
Lucid: [Of course... Good luck with your journey. I'm sure Cobby made it out. Also...]

Lucid hands you a map.

Lucid: [If you ever decide to get to Jericho, look for me in the Guild of Retrieval.]

to ant hill 2.title: Woods
to ant hill 2.text:
You and Cheese part ways with Lucid and Pemmi.

Cheese: [You wanna visit Stone Henge before we go?]

to ant hill 3-1.title: Stone Henge
to ant hill 3-1.text: You and Cheese sneak into Stone Henge again.

to ant hill 3-1 2.title: Stone Henge
to ant hill 3-1 2.text:
Just as you leave, you were spotted by a particularly perceptive guard.

Guard: [Hey, you there, stop!]

to ant hill 3-1 3.title: Woods
to ant hill 3-1 3.text: You hurriedly run out of Stone Henge and head to Ant Hill.

to ant hill 3-2.title: Fields
to ant hill 3-2.text:
You are now on your way back to Ant Hill.

This is your fourth time walking the route between Stone Henge and Ant Hill.
You maneuver the familiar path with ease, taking down monsters and sourcing food with proficiency.

However, without Cobby to nag Cheese to walk faster, you travel pretty slowly.

to ant hill 3-2 2.title: Fields
to ant hill 3-2 2.text:
A week passes, and you have arrived at Ant Hill outskirts.

Cheese: [I wonder if I could sneak into my dad's room and steal all his gold.]

You look around the settlement.
There is no one outside, and the gate to the underground is shut.

to ant hill 4-2.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 4-2.text:
You try to loot the unoccupied vendors, but you find all of them cleaned of anything of value.
Some vendors were burnt down.

Cheese: [Don't they store stocks in here? Why are they all empty?]

You feel that something is wrong.
What's going on here?

to ant hill 4-1.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 4-1.text:
You climb the mound of Ant Hill to find that the gate is barricaded with wood and chitin splinters.
There are spots of blood splattered on the floor.

It looks like there has been an attack on Ant Hill...

to ant hill 5-1.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 5-1.text:
You shout for attention.
It is completely silent, and there is no response from inside the gate.

Cheese: [Why did you do that? We're exiled, remember?]

to ant hill 6.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 6.text:
You move around the wooden blockades and sharp chitin splinters to make way to the gate.
The iron gate is firmly locked, so you dig the dirt under the gate to pass through.
Inside the gate you find some more blood splattered around the hole to the underground.

You proceed to enter the underground section of Ant Hill.

to ant hill 7.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 7.text:
You enter the darkness leading to underground Ant Hill.

Cheese: [Good thing I bought these mushroom bundle from that cave.]

Cheese takes out his glowing mushroom bundle from his bag to light the way.
The light reveals three armed people in the darkness with their weapons up.

???: [Stop!]

It's Sugar's voice.

Sugar: [Heh, looks like we're all here again. Did you chase me for the amulet? Or to save Cobby? Doesn't matter. You are on a good timing. We can use a hand here.]

Cheese: [Give me my amulet back, you bitch!]

Sugar: [Now, Cheese. You know you won't be any more useful with this amulet. Ant Hill is in trouble, and I'm not gonna waste my time fooling around with you. Get lost.]

to ant hill 8.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 8.text:
Sugar signs the guards to go back to their posts.
The guards sheathe their weapons and go away.

Sugar: [I came crashing down on Ant Hill, is what happened. I put down all the morons who tried to arrest me and gathered my fellow hunters against that mad priest.]

Sugar: [Turns out, Cobby became one of them. Maybe the priest found a use for him, and Cobby got in on the deal? What a disappointment, he was a fine hunter.]

to ant hill 9.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 9.text:
Sugar: [Just when we were bickering at each other the spiders came. I mean, what a god damn timing. The spiders came in a pretty large group and we all huddled up in here for them to pass...]

Sugar: [But in here the bickering got worse till one of my hunters killed one of theirs, and shit went down. Now the priest, Cobby, and the rest of his zealots hide in the lower section of the tunnels near the temple while me and my followers take these upper tunnels.]

Cheese suddenly jumps at Sugar and reach for her amulet.
Sugar throws him on the ground and punches him in the stomach.

Cheese: [Oof!]

Sugar: [Do I look like I'm fooling around? Stay down!]

to ant hill 10.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 10.text:
Sugar: [Anyways... I might be a lil rough around the edges but I know this shit is wrong. I don't want blood all over Ant Hill, you know? But the priest and Cobby doesn't want to change their old ways, and they're trying to convert my people at every given chance... I might have to make a bloody decision soon.]

You help Cheese up.

to ant hill 11.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 11.text:
Sugar: [Yea, go ahead. There's a chance the priest might try to detain you like he did before, so be on your guard. Might also be a good idea to drop off Cheese there. He's a burden. What the?]

Sugar suddenly trips and falls.
Cheese jumps her again and takes her amulet from her neck.
The guards charge at Cheese, but Cheese uses the amulet to turn into spirit form and fades away into darkness.

Cheese: [See ya, sucker!]

Sugar: [SON OF A -!! When did he learn to cast? UGH! Catch that idiot!]

The guards scatter to find Cheese.
Sugar gets up.

Sugar: [Ugh, anyways, go talk to Cobby, try to beat some sense into him. I'm going to go teach this moron some respect.]

to ant hill 12.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 12.text:
You descend down the dirt halls.
Further down, glowing mushrooms lining the halls were destroyed, so you pluck a few and carry it around with you to light the way.

???: [Stop!]

You tell them that you come in peace, and that you wish to speak to Cobby.

Two guards appear from the shadows and approach you.
They take your weapons away.

Guard: [Don't make any sudden moves. Follow me.]

to ant hill 13.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 13.text:
The guard escort you into the Ant Hill temple.

You look around the temple.
It smells like the whole place was covered in blood at one point.
Near the altar you see Cobby tending to the wounds of a critically wounded patient... The priest.

Cobby turns his head toward you.

Cobby: [Hey! You're alive! Thank God!]

to ant hill 14.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 14.text:
You greet him and share your side of the story, leading all the way up to meeting him.

Cobby: [So Sugar is willing to shed blood, eh? Sugar is a great hunter, but he is reckless. He stormed the temple with his friends, seized power, then announced the truth to everyone.]

opt.text: So what happened to you after we separated?

to ant hill 15.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 15.text:
Cobby: [After I escaped the temple, I hid myself in the storage tunnels. I stayed there for a day then sneaked out to the surface.]

Cobby: [Once I was out, I stayed around Ant Hill... far away enough not to be caught again but close enough to know what was going on.
When Sugar came crashing down on Ant Hill with her strange powers, I returned to Ant Hill. I found out that Sugar had detained the priest for execution... But I believed what Sugar was doing was too radical, so I came in and freed the priest and joined the rest of the Ant Hill who didn't think what Sugar was doing was right.]

to ant hill 16.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 16.text:
Cobby sighs.

Cobby: [Turns out, as messed up as it looks, the priest had his reasons to hide all this stuff from the people. If you haven't figured it out by now, let me tell you.]

Cobby: [These spiders... The priest told me how wickedly intelligent they are. When they attack a settlement, they pick off the strongest members and let the settlement repopulate.]

Cobby: [Years ago, when the leaders of Stone Henge first realized this, they have learned to just let a few people die every month. The spiders are too strong, and they couldn't risk their hunters dying off.]

Cobby: [Few years passed... They've learned to deliberately sacrifice some less useful folks every month to minimize the damage to their community... And have helped Ant Hill do the same.]

to ant hill 17.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 17.text:
Cobby: [The leaders of Ant Hill and Stone Henge know just how strong the horned spiders are. We don't stand a chance.
Sugar wants to fight the spiders, but it's completely hopeless. They are strong, organized, and outnumber us by far. Every previous attempt to fight them ended with a massacre.]

Cobby: [But we're not completely without hope... There was a man here in Ant Hill by the name of Lucid. He had promised us that he will try to get help from his home settlement. But when he silently left Ant Hill, we thought he had bailed... But if your stories are true, we may be able to get us help from the outside.]

to ant hill 18.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 18.text: Cobby: [If Sugar wants to start a bloodshed, we won't stand a chance. She has the best hunters of Ant Hill by her side, hunters who are too full of pride to accept our reality. I'm going to surrender. It's better to spill blood fighting the spiders than amongst ourselves.]

opt.to: >save>temp>You said you will try to convince Sugar?>@to ant hill 19
>save>temp>You said you will try to get help from Jericho?>@to ant hill 19
opt.text: I'm going to get help from Jericho

opt.to: >save>temp>You said you will try to look for ways to fight the spiders?>@to ant hill 19
opt.text: I'll look for ways to fight the spiders

to ant hill 19.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 19.text:
Cobby: [I see. Whatever you are up to, good luck.]

The wounded patient in front of him slowly raises his hand.
You realize that the patient is the priest of Ant Hill who had exiled you and Cobby.

Priest: [Wait... Is Cheese with you?]

It looks like the priest had been impaled several times before Cobby saved him.

Priest: [...Please tell him that I'm sorry.]

opt.text: Why did you send him to die in the first place?

to ant hill 20.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 20.text:
Priest: [I am the priest of Ant Hill... I have given up my name and my life to lead our people... as such, I must make choices for all of Ant Hill...]

Priest: [I couldn't put his life over other valuable hunters of Ant Hill... To be honest, he isn't the brightest kid...]

opt.text: Give the priest your Priest Sigil

to ant hill 20 heal.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 20 heal.text:
Priest: [This... this is the priest sigil from Stone Henge!]

The priest wears the sigil on his head.
His pale face seems to regain color.

Cobby: [Where did you...? Never mind.]

Priest: [I don't know what to say... You've saved my life. Now, I need to do what I must do. I shall surrender to Sugar.]

Cobby: [...!]

Priest: [I do not wish Ant Hill to spill blood amongst its own people. Even if we stand no chance against the spiders, it's better than... this.]

Cobby: [I understand.]

Priest: [And, you've come here with Cheese, right? Can you... Never mind. I'll face him when Ant Hill is in a better condition.]

Priest: [%?temp... You do what you must do, and I shall do mine. Good luck, and god bless.]

You leave Cobby and the priest behind and climb back up the halls toward Sugar.

to ant hill 21.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 21.text:
Cobby: [I don't think the priest will make it. After he passes away, I will surrender to Sugar. %?temp Good luck.]

You leave Cobby and the priest behind and climb back up the halls toward Sugar.

to ant hill 22.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 22.text:
The guards let you pass without any hassle.
You arrive at the entrance tunnels.

There are a dozen guards in the room and Sugar laying on the ground in the center, screaming at the guards.

Sugar: [Kill him! Find and Kill HIM!]

You ask one of the guards what happened and he tells you that Cheese came back and attacked Sugar while he was resting.

Guard: [He also hid away Sugar's weapons and put feces in his food... Cheese better be running right now.]

It doesn't look like Sugar is in any mood for conversation.

to ant hill 23.title: Ant Hill
to ant hill 23.text:
You return to the surface.

On your way down the streets, you see a floating purple thing in the distance slowing hovering away.

You follow it into the woods.

After few minutes of looking around, you find Cheese sitting on a tree eating a boiled egg.

He stares at you.
